source: RFC 0014 R1 on stored records and G5 (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24, after the red-team review CE-9, CE-10, CE-15); RFC 0014 §5 (sentences proposed in the PR)
statement: A stored record's format number is kept for a change no reader of the major version can follow, and changes only with the major version: within 8.x a session record is format 2 at most (format 2 being a session a tenant switch started, IDN-36, the 8.0 baseline) and every other record format 1. A higher format is refused as one a later version wrote. What 8.x adds within a format is a member, with crit when ignoring or dropping it would widen anything.
guards: cocache:TokenFamilyMembersTest#the session's format numbers are frozen for 8_x
document:StoredCritTest#a later format is a later version's too, and counts as one
cocache:StoredRecordMembersTest#the records' format numbers are frozen for 8_x
